## Key Projects & Case Studies
1. **Nexus Scholar (AI Knowledge Graph & Research Engine)**
   - Autonomous scientific discovery system combining Neo4j graph topologies with pgvector semantic retrieval, LangGraph agents, and Next.js 15.
   - Live URL: https://www.mayankraj.me/case-study/nexus-scholar
2. **Akion Fintech (Autonomous Algo-Trading & Financial Analytics)**
   - Sub-millisecond market execution dashboard, WebSocket streaming order books, and real-time algorithmic portfolio risk modeling.
   - Live URL: https://www.mayankraj.me/case-study/akion-fintech
3. **Credex (Smart P2P Lending & Micro-Financing Engine)**
   - Decentralized credit-scoring algorithm, automated escrow contracts, and responsive Next.js frontend.
   - Live URL: https://www.mayankraj.me/case-study/credex
4. **YOLOv11 Real-Time Deep Learning Suite**
   - High-throughput computer vision pipeline achieving 94.6% mAP@0.5 on industrial safety inspection.
   - Live URL: https://www.mayankraj.me/case-study/yolo11-deep-learning
5. **Roshan Enterprises (Enterprise B2B Distribution Suite)**
   - High-performance inventory management platform processing 10,000+ SKU sync operations.
   - Live URL: https://www.mayankraj.me/case-study/roshan-enterprises
